# Robin Francis - AI Innovator & Community Leader

> Portfolio of Robin Francis — AI innovator, community leader, and 3× hackathon winner building accessible, people-centric technology and scalable digital solutions.

## About

Robin Francis is an AI innovator, community leader, and software engineer from Kerala, India. He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science from Sahrdaya College of Engineering & Technology (2021-2025, CGPA: 7.17).

## Key Achievements

- **IEEE R10 Outstanding Volunteer Award 2024**: First student from the Asia-Pacific Region to receive this honor
- **IBM Watsonx GenAI Challenge**: 1st Runner-Up for building an intelligent GenAI-powered solution
- **3× Hackathon Winner**: Wins include GenAI challenges, food sustainability platforms, and game development competitions
- **Champion of Impact**: IEEE Computer Society recognition for founding & leading a flagship event with 450+ participants
- **Fundraising**: Raised $2,650+ for community-impact projects
- **National Bronze Medalist**: .22 Rifle Shooting competition in Delhi

## Featured Projects

### SoulSync
AI Companion for Cognitive Wellness featuring facial recognition, emotion tracking, and memory recall for elders and caregivers.
- Technologies: AI, Facial Recognition, Wellness Tech

### FoodLoop
AI Platform for Responsible Food Redistribution using ML surplus prediction to reduce food waste.
- Technologies: Machine Learning, Sustainability, React

### TechX Infinia
Emerging Tech Flagship Event - Founded and led a large-scale tech festival with 450+ participants.
- Role: Leadership, Event Management, Strategy

### IEEE R10 Career Fair
Co-led the first international virtual career fair with 31 global recruiters and 245 participants.
- Role: Global Community, Networking

### STRIDE Website
Official website for STRIDE Kerala - Central digital hub for assistive technology innovation.
- Technologies: Web Development, Accessibility, UI/UX

### Argus
Local-first autonomous QA browser agent that scouts a website, understands product flows, deploys synthetic users, and returns evidence-backed bug reports.
- Repository: https://github.com/robinfrancis186/argus.git
- Technologies: AI QA, browser automation, local-first testing

### BulkyFi
Local-first bulk certificate generator for creating professional certificates from templates and recipient spreadsheets, with browser storage and PDF/PNG export.
- Live app: https://bulkyfi.vercel.app/
- Repository: https://github.com/robinfrancis186/bulkyfi
- Technologies: Web app, local-first storage, PDF/PNG export

## Website Implementation

- Uses Vercel security headers including CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and nosniff.
